method: Built the candidate and reproduced the exact server assembly expression from src/server.ts with public/player.html and dist/player.js. Compared the current String.replace(replacementString) behavior with a callback replacement, and parsed each resulting inline script using Node's Function parser.
build: npm run build passed; dist/server.js and dist/player.js pass node --check.
conclusion: The candidate's HTML assembly is malformed because String.replace interprets replacement metasequences in the bundled JavaScript. This independently reproduces a broken UI resource and plausibly explains a blank host UI with an indefinitely opening tool result. The owner reports that the live host displayed that symptom, but has not confirmed which candidate version was deployed.
